verdict.rationale: Dropbox Dash offers AI-driven natural-language querying — summarizing files, getting AI answers, organizing/reviewing documents — which lets users interact via NL for search/insight tasks, but there's no evidence of natural-language commands driving broader product actions (e.g., moving, sharing, or managing files) beyond Dash's search/summarize features. missing for 10: NL command execution for core file operations (upload, share, move, permissions), evidence of a conversational agent controlling Dropbox actions, independent corroboration of Dash's NL capabilities.
